# The allow-list of the EBMC differential tier (CONTRACT.md 3-4; format and token rules in the
# docstring of tests/support/ebmc_differential.py, parse_allow_list and property_tokens).
#
# Nothing is compared unless a shape below admits it. A trace case is named
# <trace file stem>:<case name>. Order matters: the first matching exclude line gives the reason
# a case is not compared; the first admitting shape of each engine compares it.
#
# Exclusions: the areas where the EBMC study found that EBMC's
# reading differs from IEEE 1800-2017 or is not decidable here, so that agreement would prove
# nothing and disagreement would be noise.
exclude disable-iff @disable
exclude initial-procedure @procedure
exclude assume-kind @assume
exclude x-z-literal @xz-literal
exclude cover-vacuity @cover+|-> @cover+|=>
exclude sampled-value-functions $past $rose $fell $stable $changed $sampled
exclude isunknown $isunknown
exclude system-functions $onehot $onehot0 $countones $bits $clog2
exclude inside inside
exclude goto-nonconsecutive-ranges [->m:n] [->m:$] [=N] [=m:n] [=m:$]
exclude pending-match-operators intersect within throughout
exclude unbounded-under-not not+##[m:$] not+[*m:$] not+s_eventually not+until not+s_until not+until_with not+s_until_with not+strong not+weak

# --- BMC: finite and bounded properties, compared on the written samples ---------------------

== bmc-sequences
engine: bmc
kinds: assert cover
vocabulary: ##N ##[m:n] and or
positive: cover_pending:cover_sequence_ends_once_per_sample
negative: ieee_directives:ieee_16_14_8_a_sequence_is_always_nonvacuous
note: Boolean expressions, fixed delays, bounded delay ranges, and/or of sequences (asserts and covers)

== bmc-repetition
engine: bmc
kinds: assert cover
vocabulary: ##N ##[m:n] [*N] [*m:n] and or |-> |=>
requires: [*N] [*m:n]
positive: repetition:p08_three_in_a_row
negative: repetition:p08_gap_fails
note: consecutive repetition with fixed bounds

== bmc-implication
engine: bmc
kinds: assert
vocabulary: ##N ##[m:n] [*N] [*m:n] and or |-> |=>
requires: |-> |=>
positive: delays:p05_latest_valid_match
negative: delays:p05_fail_at_last_chance
note: overlapping and non-overlapping implication of bounded sequences

== bmc-not
engine: bmc
kinds: assert
vocabulary: ##N ##[m:n] [*N] [*m:n] and or |-> |=> not
requires: not
positive: not:not_after_nonoverlapping_implication_passes
negative: not:not_fails_at_the_first_match
note: not of a bounded sequence or property

== bmc-if-else
engine: bmc
kinds: assert
vocabulary: ##N ##[m:n] [*N] [*m:n] and or |-> |=> not if else
requires: if else
positive: ieee_directives:ieee_16_14_8_g_if_else_selected_branch
negative: if:if_else_selects_one_branch
note: if (b) p else q

== bmc-until
engine: bmc
kinds: assert
vocabulary: ##N ##[m:n] [*N] [*m:n] and or |-> |=> not if else until s_until
requires: until s_until
positive: ieee_properties:ieee_16_12_12_until_weak_p1
negative: ieee_properties:ieee_16_12_12_until_left_drops_before_right
note: until and s_until on a finite trace (a pending strong until is not a failure within the samples)

# --- BDD: unbounded recurrence on a lasso, plain --bdd (the raw directive covers every attempt) ---

== bdd-recurrence
engine: bdd
kinds: assert
vocabulary: always s_eventually
requires: s_eventually
forbids: @eventually-always
positive: lasso:always_eventually_infinitely_often
negative: lasso:always_eventually_b_only_once
note: always s_eventually and s_eventually (EBMC wraps a directive in always, so both are recurrence); plain --bdd refuses implication into s_eventually and s_eventually always (not supported by the BDD engine)

# --- BUECHI: --bdd --buechi on a lasso, one assertion per start (Spot's ltl2tgba on the PATH) ---

== buechi-strong-sequence
engine: buechi
kinds: assert
vocabulary: strong ##N ##[m:n] ##[m:$] [*N] [*m:n] [*m:$] [->N] and or |->
requires: strong
positive: strong_liveness:strong_consequent_with_a_and_b_at_every_sample
negative: constants:lasso_strong_constant_false_after_an_unbounded_delay_is_false_for_ever
note: strong sequences, also as the consequent of an implication

== buechi-s-until
engine: buechi
kinds: assert
vocabulary: s_until s_until_with
requires: s_until s_until_with
positive: strong_liveness:s_until_c_in_the_loop
negative: strong_liveness:s_until_never_c_while_b_holds
note: strong until

== buechi-eventually-always
engine: buechi
kinds: assert
vocabulary: s_eventually always
requires: @eventually-always
forbids: @recurrence
positive: ieee_properties:ieee_16_12_13_s_eventually_always_stays_high_p2
negative: ieee_properties:ieee_16_12_13_s_eventually_always_alternating_p2
note: s_eventually always

== buechi-s-eventually
engine: buechi
kinds: assert
vocabulary: s_eventually |->
requires: s_eventually
positive: lasso:s_eventually_b_periodic
negative: lasso:s_eventually_b_never
note: s_eventually and implication into it, each attempt alone (not under always: no recurrence)
